name: Facial lifting tape
lead: Facial lifting tape consists of adhesive strips or invisible patches placed on the cheeks, jawline or temples and pulled back, often hidden by hair, to temporarily smooth and lift sagging skin. It has been used in photography, TV and event styling for years.
The effect is cosmetic and instant, and lasts only while the tape is on.

paras: The adhesive physically holds skin in a tighter position, so the lift is mechanical, not biological. Nothing changes in collagen or tissue structure.

Risks are skin irritation, adhesive allergy and redness on removal, and wearing it overnight can leave marks. Studies on facial tape concern post-surgical swelling and the mechanics of taped skin, not anti-aging, so the research does not validate long-term claims. The effect is reliable but only temporary.
